data_contract.censoring_basis: Adopt published common five-year administrative censoring; per-patient dates not independently verified
data_contract.eligibility: official423; Alive and label0 censored at1825; label1 and 0<death_day<=1825 are events; exclude nine late days and one zero day; preserve original split

partial_training: 25 percent zero;25 percent full;50 percent uniform intermediate acquirable region count; case/epoch seeded
selection: minimum equally weighted mean Validation discrete survival NLL over all five fixed observation modes
evaluation: NLL;Harrell C-index using minus mean annual survival;1/3/5-year AUROC and Brier;annual-grid trapezoidal integrated Brier over0..1825;not individual death-day regression
auxiliary: same head and fusion projection;coarse-only shares coarse trunk;fine-only fixed-query pooling shares fine projection/local attention/encoder/pool;not new private auxiliary heads
parameter_origin: registered engineering starting configuration;annual bins fixed without outcome-driven tuning;no efficacy guarantee
